capabilities: Show each pinned folder as tab root
Remember per-tab expand state and scroll position
Switch tab bar layout (grid, vertical, horizontal)
Jump to parent folder with Go Up button
extras: Desktop only; uses Node APIs not available on mobile. Requires Obsidian 1.6.2 or newer. Manual install required while the community marketplace listing is pending.
intentEvidence: Pin folders as tabs in the Obsidian file explorer.
motivation: Working across many large projects in a single vault means constantly expanding, collapsing, and scrolling the file tree to switch context.
problem: Switching between large projects in one vault requires constantly expanding, collapsing, and scrolling the file tree.
summary: File explorer plugin that pins folders as tabs, each showing that folder as its root for one-click project context switching.
